list.name: instrument_type
list.label: Type
list.query: Shares : share, Units / ETFs / FIIs : unit, BDRs : bdr, Odd lot : odd_lot, Call options : call, Put options : put, Forwards (termo) : forward, Rights & receipts : rights, Other : other

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]') THEN if(substr(ticker, 5, 1) <= 'L', 'call', 'put')
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}T$') THEN 'forward'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[3-8]$') THEN 'share'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}11$') THEN 'unit'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}3[1-9]$') THEN 'bdr'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}(1|2|9|10|12|13|14|15)$') THEN 'rights'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS instrument_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker
FROM t
WHERE instrument_type IN ($instrument_type)
GROUP BY ticker
HAVING sum(regular_trades) > 0
ORDER BY sum(regular_trades) DESC
LIMIT 1000

      ELSE 'other'
    END AS instrument_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')

    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, arg_max(last_price, regular_trades)::DOUBLE AS close
  FROM t
  WHERE instrument_type IN ($instrument_type)
    AND last_price > 0

r AS (
  SELECT ticker, arg_max(close, trad_dt) / arg_min(close, trad_dt) - 1 AS period_return
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT avg(period_return) AS avg_return
FROM r

panels.description: Daily trades of every instrument sharing the selected tickers' 4-letter root (shares, odd lot, options, forwards...), stacked by type; ignores the type filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]') THEN if(substr(ticker, 5, 1) <= 'L', 'call', 'put')
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}T$') THEN 'forward'

      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}3[1-9]$') THEN 'bdr'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}(1|2|9|10|12|13|14|15)$') THEN 'rights'

    END AS instrument_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE left(ticker, 4) IN (SELECT left(x, 4) FROM unnest([$ticker]) AS u(x))
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Selected tickers (latest day in range)
panels.description: Prices, change vs previous close, trades and open interest for the selected tickers on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]') THEN if(substr(ticker, 5, 1) <= 'L', 'call', 'put')
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}T$') THEN 'forward'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[3-8]$') THEN 'share'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}11$') THEN 'unit'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}3[1-9]$') THEN 'bdr'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}(1|2|9|10|12|13|14|15)$') THEN 'rights'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS instrument_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    ticker,
    any_value(instrument_type) AS type,
    arg_max(first_price, regular_trades)::DOUBLE AS open,
    max(max_price)::DOUBLE AS high,
    min(min_price)::DOUBLE AS low,
    (sum(avg_price * regular_trades) / sum(regular_trades))::DOUBLE AS avg_price,
    arg_max(last_price, regular_trades)::DOUBLE AS close,
    sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades,
    sum(open_interest)::BIGINT AS open_interest
  FROM t
  WHERE instrument_type IN ($instrument_type)
    AND last_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trad_dt, ticker
),
w AS (
  SELECT *, lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_close
  FROM daily
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  type,
  open,
  high,
  low,
  avg_price,
  close,
  prev_close,
  close / nullif(prev_close, 0) - 1 AS change,
  trades,
  open_interest
FROM w
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM w WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY trades DESC
